newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NeoMagic started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NeoMagic started at buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it has started coverage of NewMagic Corp, a maker of specialized computer graphics microchips, with a buy rating.
-- Hambrecht believes the company can grow earnings 55 percent in 1999 over 1998. It has a six month price target of $23 a share, or 32 times its 1999 estimate of $0.71/shr.
-- Earlier, the company reported a first quarter 1997 profit of $0.09/shr versus a loss of $0.06/shr one year ago.
-- Hambrecht attributed the Q1 results to gains in market share. It noted NeoMagic's graphics controllers are being used by 8 of the top 10 notebook PC original equipment makers.
